blocks.title: Unified Modeling Language (UML)
blocks.text: Unified Modeling Language (UML) is a standardized way to visualize the design of a software system. It helps developers understand how a system works and communicates, and makes complex systems easier to understand and manage.
UML was created by three software engineers, Grady Booch, James Rumbaugh and Ivar Jacobson, often called the 'Three Amigos' of UML (Did You Know).
